import HydrologyTree.StieltjesDegree
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Polynomial

/-! Actual real zeros between every pair of consecutive Stieltjes poles.
Existence follows from a proved polynomial sign calculation and the IVT;
it is not supplied by a spectral oracle or a root-finding computation. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : i.castSucc < i.succ := by
  change i.val < i.val+1
  omega

lemma fin_stieltjes_outside_adjacent {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n+1))
    (hlo : j ≠ i.castSucc) (hhi : j ≠ i.succ) : j < i.castSucc ∨ i.succ < j := by
  have hl : j.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hlo (Fin.ext h)
  have hh : j.val ≠ i.val+1 := fun h => hhi (Fin.ext h)
  change j.val < i.val ∨ i.val+1 < j.val
  omega

lemma adjacentPole_other_product_pos {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : StrictMono r)
    (i : Fin n) :
    0 < ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc).erase i.succ,
      (r j-r i.castSucc)*(r j-r i.succ) := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro j hj
  have hji : j ≠ i.castSucc := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).2).1
  have hjs : j ≠ i.succ := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
  rcases fin_stieltjes_outside_adjacent i j hji hjs with hlt | hgt
  · exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr (hr hlt))
      (sub_neg.mpr (hr (lt_trans hlt (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i))))
  · exact mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hr (lt_trans (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i) hgt)))
      (sub_pos.mpr (hr hgt))

/-- Consecutive pole evaluations of the ACTUAL numerator have opposite signs. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_adjacent_poles_opposite {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : Fin n) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.castSucc) *
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.succ) < 0 := by
  have hneq : i.castSucc ≠ i.succ := ne_of_lt (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i)
  have hs : i.succ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n+1))).erase i.castSucc := by simp [Ne.symm hneq]
  have hl : i.castSucc ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n+1))).erase i.succ := by simp [hneq]
  have hgap : 0 < r i.succ-r i.castSucc := sub_pos.mpr (hr (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i))
  have hrest := adjacentPole_other_product_pos r hr i
  have herase : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n+1))).erase i.succ).erase i.castSucc =
      (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc).erase i.succ := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase]
    tauto
  have hid : (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.castSucc) *
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.succ) =
      -((w i.castSucc*w i.succ)*(r i.succ-r i.castSucc)^2 *
        ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc).erase i.succ,
          (r j-r i.castSucc)*(r j-r i.succ)) := by
    rw [stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole,stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole,
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc) (fun j => r j-r i.castSucc) hs,
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase i.succ) (fun j => r j-r i.succ) hl,
      herase,Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    ring
  rw [hid]
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (hw _) (hw _)) (sq_pos_of_pos hgap)) hrest)

lemma polynomial_zero_between_opposite (p : ℝ[X]) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (h : p.eval a*p.eval b < 0) : ∃ z : ℝ, a < z ∧ z < b ∧ p.eval z = 0 := by
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.uIcc (p.eval a) (p.eval b) := by
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc]
    rcases mul_neg_iff.mp h with ⟨ha,hb⟩ | ⟨ha,hb⟩
    all_goals first | exact Or.inl ⟨ha.le,hb.le⟩ | exact Or.inr ⟨hb.le,ha.le⟩
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hzero⟩ := intermediate_value_uIcc (p.continuous.continuousOn) hu
  change p.eval z = 0 at hzero
  have hz' : a ≤ z ∧ z ≤ b := by simpa only [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le,Set.mem_Icc] using hz
  have hza : z ≠ a := by intro he; rw [he] at hzero; rw [hzero,zero_mul] at h; exact (lt_irrefl _ h)
  have hzb : z ≠ b := by intro he; rw [he] at hzero; rw [hzero,mul_zero] at h; exact (lt_irrefl _ h)
  exact ⟨z,lt_of_le_of_ne hz'.1 (Ne.symm hza),lt_of_le_of_ne hz'.2 hzb,hzero⟩

/-- An actual numerator zero strictly between each consecutive pair of poles. -/
theorem stieltjes_interlacing_zero_exists {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ b : ℝ, r i.castSucc < b ∧ b < r i.succ ∧ (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-b)=0 := by
  have hg : r i.castSucc < r i.succ := hr (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i)
  have hs := stieltjesNumerator_adjacent_poles_opposite r w hr hw i
  rw [mul_comm] at hs
  obtain ⟨z,hz1,hz2,hzero⟩ := polynomial_zero_between_opposite
    (stieltjesNumerator r w) (-r i.succ) (-r i.castSucc) (neg_lt_neg hg) hs
  refine ⟨-z,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · simpa only [neg_neg] using hzero

/-- Choose all zeros together; uniqueness and full factorization are established separately. -/
def stieltjesZeroRates {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => Classical.choose (stieltjes_interlacing_zero_exists r w hr hw i)

lemma stieltjesZeroRates_spec {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : Fin n) :
    r i.castSucc < stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i ∧
      stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i < r i.succ ∧
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i)=0 :=
  Classical.choose_spec (stieltjes_interlacing_zero_exists r w hr hw i)

theorem stieltjesZeroRates_strictMono {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) : StrictMono (stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw) := by
  intro i j hij
  have h1 := (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).2.1
  have h2 := (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw j).1
  have hmid : r i.succ ≤ r j.castSucc := hr.monotone (by
    change i.val+1 ≤ j.val
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show i.val < j.val from hij))
  exact lt_trans (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 hmid) h2

lemma stieltjesZeroRates_pos {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 < r j) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i :=
  lt_trans (hpos i.castSucc) (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).1

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.StieltjesInterlacing

/-! Complete numerator factorization by the interlacing zeros constructed from
positive weights. This establishes every zero and its simplicity, not merely
existence of a selection of roots. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma stieltjesDenominator_degree_card {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (r : I → ℝ) :
    (stieltjesDenominator r).natDegree = Fintype.card I := by
  classical
  rw [stieltjesDenominator,Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _
    (fun i _ => Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (r i))]
  simp

lemma stieltjes_numerator_interlacing_divides {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) :
    stieltjesDenominator (stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw) ∣ stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  unfold stieltjesDenominator
  apply Fintype.prod_dvd_of_coprime
  · have hmono := stieltjesZeroRates_strictMono r w hr hw
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => -stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i) :=
      neg_injective.comp hmono.injective
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,Function.onFun,map_neg,sub_neg_eq_add] using
      Polynomial.pairwise_coprime_X_sub_C hinj
  · intro i
    have h := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).2.2
    simpa only [map_neg,sub_neg_eq_add] using h

/-- Complete monic numerator factorization at the constructed interlacing roots.
The normalization is explicit and n=0 is included. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    stieltjesNumerator r w = stieltjesDenominator (stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw) := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
    (stieltjesDenominator_monic _) (normalized_stieltjesNumerator_monic r w hm)
    (stieltjes_numerator_interlacing_divides r w hr hw)
  rw [normalized_stieltjesNumerator_degree r w hm,stieltjesDenominator_degree_card]
  simp

/-- No additional real numerator zeros exist outside the constructed family. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (b : ℝ) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-b)=0 ↔ ∃ i : Fin n, b=stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i := by
  rw [stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization r w hr hw hm,eval_stieltjesDenominator,
    Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i,hi⟩
    exact ⟨i,by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨i,hi⟩
    exact ⟨i,by rw [hi]; ring⟩

lemma stieltjesDenominator_derivative {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (r : I → ℝ) :
    (stieltjesDenominator r).derivative = stieltjesNumerator r (fun _ => 1) := by
  rw [stieltjesDenominator,Polynomial.derivative_prod_finset]
  simp [stieltjesNumerator]

/-- Each interlacing zero is simple: the derivative value is an explicit
nonzero product of distinct zero-rate differences. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_derivative_at_zero {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (i : Fin n) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).derivative.eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
        (stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw j-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i) := by
  rw [stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization r w hr hw hm,
    stieltjesDenominator_derivative,stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole,one_mul]

theorem stieltjesNumerator_simple_zeros {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (i : Fin n) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).derivative.eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [stieltjesNumerator_derivative_at_zero r w hr hw hm]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  intro he
  exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
    ((stieltjesZeroRates_strictMono r w hr hw).injective (sub_eq_zero.mp he))

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.StieltjesZeroFactorization
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Inv

/-! Positive residues of the reciprocal Stieltjes response, from the actual
polynomial derivative and a proved analytic sign identity. -/
open Polynomial
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma stieltjesZero_not_original_pole {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n+1)) :
    -stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i+r j ≠ 0 := by
  have hb := stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i
  by_cases hj : j ≤ i.castSucc
  · have h := hr.monotone hj
    linarith
  · have hj' : i.succ ≤ j := by
      change i.val+1 ≤ j.val
      have hh : ¬j.val ≤ i.val := hj
      omega
    have h := hr.monotone hj'
    linarith

lemma stieltjesResponse_hasDerivAt {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (r w : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z => ∑ i, w i/(z+r i)) (-(∑ i, w i/(s+r i)^2)) s := by
  have h (i : I) : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => w i/(z+r i)) (-w i/(s+r i)^2) s := by
    simpa only [zero_mul,zero_sub,mul_one,id_eq] using
      (hasDerivAt_const s (w i)).fun_div ((hasDerivAt_id s).add_const (r i)) (hs i)
  simpa only [div_neg,neg_div,Finset.sum_neg_distrib] using
    (HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => h i))

/-- The quotient of the actual numerator and denominator equals the actual
Stieltjes sum on its entire nonpole domain. -/
lemma stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (r w : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval s/(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s =
      ∑ i, w i/(s+r i) := by
  have hd : (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hs i)
  exact (div_eq_iff hd).mpr (stieltjes_sum_mul_denominator r w s hs).symm

/-- At any actual numerator zero away from the poles, the logarithmic quotient
of derivatives is the strictly signed reciprocal-square sum. -/
theorem stieltjes_derivative_ratio_at_zero {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (r w : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0)
    (hzero : (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval s=0) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).derivative.eval s/(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s =
      -(∑ i, w i/(s+r i)^2) := by
  have hd : (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hs i)
  have hq := (stieltjesNumerator r w).hasDerivAt s |>.fun_div
    ((stieltjesDenominator r).hasDerivAt s) hd
  have hratio : ((stieltjesNumerator r w).derivative.eval s*(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s -
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval s*(stieltjesDenominator r).derivative.eval s)/
      (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s^2 =
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).derivative.eval s/(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s := by
    rw [hzero,zero_mul,sub_zero]
    field_simp
  rw [hratio] at hq
  have he : (fun z => ∑ i, w i/(z+r i)) =ᶠ[nhds s]
      (fun z => (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval z/(stieltjesDenominator r).eval z) := by
    filter_upwards [(stieltjesDenominator r).continuousAt.eventually_ne hd] with z hz
    have hi : ∀ i, z+r i ≠ 0 := by
      rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator,Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff] at hz
      exact fun i => hz i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact (stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum r w z hi).symm
  exact (hq.congr_of_eventuallyEq he).unique (stieltjesResponse_hasDerivAt r w s hs)

/-- Positive coefficient of the minus-simple-pole term in the reciprocal. -/
def reciprocalResidue {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (i : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  -(stieltjesDenominator r).eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i) /
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).derivative.eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i)

/-- Every reciprocal residue is strictly positive; no sign oracle or
unproved Stieltjes transformation theorem is used. -/
theorem reciprocalResidue_pos {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < reciprocalResidue r w hr hw i := by
  have hs := stieltjesZero_not_original_pole r w hr hw i
  have hratio := stieltjes_derivative_ratio_at_zero r w _ hs
    (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).2.2
  have hsum : 0 < ∑ j, w j/(-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i+r j)^2 := by
    apply Finset.sum_pos
    · intro j _
      exact div_pos (hw j) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (hs j))
    · exact Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hneg : (stieltjesNumerator r w).derivative.eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i) /
      (stieltjesDenominator r).eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i) < 0 := by
    rw [hratio]
    exact neg_lt_zero.mpr hsum
  unfold reciprocalResidue
  rcases div_neg_iff.mp hneg with ⟨h1,h2⟩ | ⟨h1,h2⟩
  · exact div_pos (neg_pos.mpr h2) h1
  · exact div_pos_of_neg_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos h2) h1

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.StieltjesResidues

/-! Exact polynomial reconstruction of a reciprocal response. Quotient/remainder
and all residues are reconstructed from the actual polynomials and all their
simple roots; no unproved partial fraction decomposition is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_consecutive_division (P F : ℝ[X]) (hP : P.Monic) (hF : F.Monic)
    (hdeg : P.natDegree=F.natDegree+1) :
    P /ₘ F = X + C ((P /ₘ F).coeff 0) := by
  have hle : F.degree ≤ P.degree := by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hF.ne_zero,Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hP.ne_zero,hdeg]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ F.natDegree
  have hq : (P /ₘ F).Monic := by
    change (P /ₘ F).leadingCoeff=1
    rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_divByMonic_of_monic hF hle]
    exact hP
  apply hq.eq_X_add_C
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_divByMonic P hF,hdeg]
  omega

lemma stieltjesDenominator_derivative_pole {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    (stieltjesDenominator b).derivative.eval (-b i) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (b j-b i) := by
  rw [stieltjesDenominator_derivative,stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole,one_mul]

lemma stieltjesDenominator_simple {n : ℕ} (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) (i : Fin n) :
    (stieltjesDenominator b).derivative.eval (-b i) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [stieltjesDenominator_derivative_pole]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj he
  exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1 (hb (sub_eq_zero.mp he))

/-- A complete algebraic reciprocal partial fraction identity. The denominator
is monic and has exactly n prescribed distinct real zeros; P has degree n+1.
Neither signs of residues nor positivity are premises of this algebraic lemma. -/
theorem polynomial_reciprocal_interpolation {n : ℕ} (P : ℝ[X]) (b g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hP : P.Monic) (hd : P.natDegree=n+1) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (hg : ∀ i, g i = -P.eval (-b i)/(stieltjesDenominator b).derivative.eval (-b i)) :
    P = (X+C ((P /ₘ stieltjesDenominator b).coeff 0))*stieltjesDenominator b -
      stieltjesNumerator b g := by
  let F := stieltjesDenominator b
  have hF : F.Monic := stieltjesDenominator_monic b
  have hFd : F.natDegree=n := by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using stieltjesDenominator_degree_card b
  have hQ := monic_consecutive_division P F hP hF (by rw [hd,hFd])
  have hrem : P %ₘ F = -stieltjesNumerator b g := by
    by_cases hn : n=0
    · letI : IsEmpty (Fin n) := ⟨fun i => by have h := i.isLt; omega⟩
      have hF1 : F=1 := by simp [F,stieltjesDenominator]
      simp [hF1,stieltjesNumerator]
    · have hF1 : F ≠ 1 := by intro h; rw [h,Polynomial.natDegree_one] at hFd; exact hn hFd.symm
      apply Polynomial.eq_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq _ _ (neg_injective.comp hb)
      · intro i
        change (P %ₘ F).eval (-b i) = (-stieltjesNumerator b g).eval (-b i)
        have hv : (P %ₘ F).eval (-b i) = P.eval (-b i) := by
          have h := congrArg (fun Q : ℝ[X] => Q.eval (-b i)) (Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div P F)
          simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add,Polynomial.eval_mul,F,stieltjesDenominator_eval_pole,
            zero_mul,add_zero] using h
        rw [hv,Polynomial.eval_neg,stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole,hg]
        rw [← stieltjesDenominator_derivative_pole]
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (stieltjesDenominator_simple b hb i),neg_neg]
      · have hR : (P %ₘ F).natDegree < n := by
          simpa only [hFd] using Polynomial.natDegree_modByMonic_lt P hF hF1
        have hS : (stieltjesNumerator b g).natDegree < n := by
          rcases n with _ | k
          · exact False.elim (hn rfl)
          · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (stieltjesNumerator_natDegree_le b g) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)
        simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,Polynomial.natDegree_neg] using max_lt hR hS

  rw [hrem,hQ] at h
  calc
    P = -stieltjesNumerator b g + F*(X+C ((P /ₘ F).coeff 0)) := h.symm
    _ = _ := by change -stieltjesNumerator b g + F*(X+C ((P /ₘ F).coeff 0)) =

                ring

import HydrologyTree.ReciprocalInterpolation

/-! Complete constructive reciprocal Stieltjes transformation. Every zero,
residue, polynomial identity and root leak positivity is proved from the
specified positive normalized response, with the one-store case included. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def reciprocalDiagonal {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((stieltjesDenominator r /ₘ stieltjesNumerator r w).coeff 0)

/-- Complete polynomial identity for the positive reciprocal transformation. -/
theorem stieltjes_reciprocal_polynomial {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    stieltjesDenominator r = (X+C (reciprocalDiagonal r w))*stieltjesNumerator r w -
      stieltjesNumerator (stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw) (reciprocalResidue r w hr hw) := by
  have h := polynomial_reciprocal_interpolation (stieltjesDenominator r)
    (stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw) (reciprocalResidue r w hr hw)
    (stieltjesDenominator_monic r) (stieltjesDenominator_natDegree r)
    (stieltjesZeroRates_strictMono r w hr hw).injective
    (fun i => by rw [← stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization r w hr hw hm]; rfl)
  rw [← stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization r w hr hw hm] at h
  exact h

lemma stieltjesDenominator_eval_zero_pos {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (r : I → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) : 0 < (stieltjesDenominator r).eval 0 := by
  classical
  rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i _
  simpa using hr i

/-- The root-leak value required by conservative reconstruction is strictly
positive. It is computed from the original reciprocal response at zero. -/
theorem reciprocal_leak_formula {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) :
    reciprocalDiagonal r w - ∑ i : Fin n,
        reciprocalResidue r w hr hw i/stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i =
      (stieltjesDenominator r).eval 0/(stieltjesNumerator r w).eval 0 ∧
    0 < reciprocalDiagonal r w - ∑ i : Fin n,
        reciprocalResidue r w hr hw i/stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i := by
  let b := stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw
  let g := reciprocalResidue r w hr hw
  have hF : stieltjesNumerator r w = stieltjesDenominator b :=
    stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization r w hr hw hm
  have hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i := stieltjesZeroRates_pos r w hr hw hpos
  have hFpos : 0 < (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval 0 := by
    rw [hF]
    exact stieltjesDenominator_eval_zero_pos b hb
  have hDpos := stieltjesDenominator_eval_zero_pos r hpos
  have hq := stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum b g 0 (fun i => by simpa using ne_of_gt (hb i))
  have h := congrArg (fun P : ℝ[X] => P.eval 0) (stieltjes_reciprocal_polynomial r w hr hw hm)
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub,Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_add,
    Polynomial.eval_X,Polynomial.eval_C,zero_add] at h
  have he : reciprocalDiagonal r w-∑ i : Fin n, g i/b i =
      (stieltjesDenominator r).eval 0/(stieltjesNumerator r w).eval 0 := by
    rw [← hF] at hq
    simp only [zero_add] at hq
    rw [← hq]
    apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hFpos)).mpr
    rw [sub_mul,div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hFpos)]
    exact h.symm
  refine ⟨he,?_⟩
  rw [he]
  exact div_pos hDpos hFpos

/-- Complete existence theorem for the reciprocal data, all finite sizes.
No abstract interlacing theorem, residue positivity, or realization assumption
is used as an input. -/
theorem exists_positive_reciprocal_stieltjes_data {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    ∃ (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ),
      StrictMono b ∧ (∀ i, r i.castSucc < b i ∧ b i < r i.succ) ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < b i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < g i) ∧
      stieltjesNumerator r w = stieltjesDenominator b ∧
      stieltjesDenominator r = (X+C d)*stieltjesDenominator b-stieltjesNumerator b g ∧
      0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i := by
  refine ⟨stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw,reciprocalResidue r w hr hw,reciprocalDiagonal r w,
    stieltjesZeroRates_strictMono r w hr hw,?_,stieltjesZeroRates_pos r w hr hw hpos,
    reciprocalResidue_pos r w hr hw,stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization r w hr hw hm,?_,
    (reciprocal_leak_formula r w hr hw hm hpos).2⟩
  · intro i
    exact ⟨(stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).1,(stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).2.1⟩
  · rw [← stieltjesNumerator_interlacing_factorization r w hr hw hm]
    exact stieltjes_reciprocal_polynomial r w hr hw hm

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/StieltjesReindex.lean:
import HydrologyTree.StieltjesReciprocal
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sort

/-! Reindexing and sorting the actual Stieltjes data, including the empty
index type. No increasing order is imposed on the physical model's labels. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma stieltjesDenominator_reindex {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (e : I ≃ J) (r : J → ℝ) :
    stieltjesDenominator (fun i => r (e i)) = stieltjesDenominator r := by
  exact e.prod_comp (fun j => (X+C (r j) : ℝ[X]))

lemma stieltjes_erased_product_reindex {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (e : I ≃ J) (r : J → ℝ) (i : I) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r (e j)))) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (e i), (X+C (r j)) := by
  apply Finset.prod_equiv e
  · intro j
    simp
  · intro j _
    rfl

lemma stieltjesNumerator_reindex {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (e : I ≃ J) (r w : J → ℝ) :
    stieltjesNumerator (fun i => r (e i)) (fun i => w (e i)) = stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  unfold stieltjesNumerator
  simp_rw [stieltjes_erased_product_reindex e r]
  exact e.sum_comp (fun j => (C (w j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (X+C (r k)) : ℝ[X]))

/-- Every injective finite list of real rates admits a sorting permutation. -/
theorem exists_sorted_rate_permutation {n : ℕ} (r : Fin n → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) :
    ∃ e : Fin n ≃ Fin n, StrictMono (fun i => r (e i)) := by
  classical
  let s : Finset ℝ := Finset.univ.image r
  have hs : s.card=n := by simp [s,Finset.card_image_of_injective,hr]
  let o : Fin n ≃o s := s.orderIsoOfFin hs
  have hx (i : Fin n) : ∃ j : Fin n, r j=(o i).val := by
    have h := (o i).property
    simpa only [s,Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] using h
  let p : Fin n → Fin n := fun i => Classical.choose (hx i)
  have hp (i : Fin n) : r (p i)=(o i).val := Classical.choose_spec (hx i)
  have hpi : Function.Injective p := by
    intro i j hij
    apply o.injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← hp i,← hp j,hij]
  let e : Fin n ≃ Fin n := Equiv.ofBijective p ⟨hpi,Finite.surjective_of_injective hpi⟩
  refine ⟨e,?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  change r (p i) < r (p j)
  rw [hp i,hp j]
  exact o.strictMono hij

/-- Reciprocal data for arbitrary INJECTIVE rates, not only sorted input labels.
The poles of the new response are sorted; both actual input polynomials are
preserved under the sorting permutation. -/
theorem exists_positive_reciprocal_data_unordered {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i)
    (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    ∃ (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ),
      StrictMono b ∧ (∀ i, 0 < b i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 < g i) ∧
      stieltjesNumerator r w = stieltjesDenominator b ∧
      stieltjesDenominator r = (X+C d)*stieltjesDenominator b-stieltjesNumerator b g ∧
      0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i := by
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := exists_sorted_rate_permutation r hr
  have hmass : (∑ i, w (e i))=1 := (e.sum_comp w).trans hm
  obtain ⟨b,g,d,hb,_,hbpos,hg,hF,hP,hleak⟩ := exists_positive_reciprocal_stieltjes_data
    (fun i => r (e i)) (fun i => w (e i)) he (fun i => hpos (e i))
    (fun i => hw (e i)) hmass
  rw [stieltjesNumerator_reindex e r w] at hF
  rw [stieltjesDenominator_reindex e r] at hP
  exact ⟨b,g,d,hb,hbpos,hg,hF,hP,hleak⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.SizedSpectralAllocation
import HydrologyTree.StieltjesReindex

/-! Canonical block polynomials of a labelled pole allocation. The label data
are recovered from actual polynomial roots, not postulated as extra observations. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {B : Type*} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] {m : B → ℕ} {n : ℕ}

def allocatedRates (b : Fin n → ℝ) (a : SizedAllocation m n) (c : B) : Fin (m c) → ℝ :=
  fun i => b (allocationEquiv a ⟨c,i⟩)

def allocatedDenominator (b : Fin n → ℝ) (a : SizedAllocation m n) (c : B) : ℝ[X] :=
  stieltjesDenominator (allocatedRates b a c)

lemma allocationEquiv_mem_iff (a : SizedAllocation m n) (c : B) (i : Fin n) :
    (∃ j : Fin (m c), allocationEquiv a ⟨c,j⟩=i) ↔ a.val i=c := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j,rfl⟩
    exact allocationEquiv_label a c j
  · intro hi
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := (allocationEnumeration a c).surjective ⟨i,hi⟩
    exact ⟨j,congrArg Subtype.val hj⟩

/-- Membership in a labelled allocation block is equivalent to an actual zero
of its monic polynomial at the corresponding reference pole. -/
theorem allocatedDenominator_eval_zero_iff (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (a : SizedAllocation m n) (c : B) (i : Fin n) :
    (allocatedDenominator b a c).eval (-b i)=0 ↔ a.val i=c := by
  rw [allocatedDenominator,eval_stieltjesDenominator,Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff,
    ← allocationEquiv_mem_iff a c i]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j,_,hj⟩
    refine ⟨j,hb ?_⟩
    change -b i+b (allocationEquiv a ⟨c,j⟩)=0 at hj
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨j,hj⟩
    exact ⟨j,Finset.mem_univ j,by simp [allocatedRates,hj]⟩

/-- Distinct labelled allocations cannot have the same complete child factors. -/
theorem allocatedDenominators_injective (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) :
    Function.Injective (fun a : SizedAllocation m n => allocatedDenominator b a) := by
  intro a d h
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  have hh : (allocatedDenominator b a (a.val i)).eval (-b i)=0 :=
    (allocatedDenominator_eval_zero_iff b hb a (a.val i) i).mpr rfl
  rw [congrFun h (a.val i)] at hh
  exact ((allocatedDenominator_eval_zero_iff b hb d (a.val i) i).mp hh).symm

/-- Internal pole order is immaterial: the canonical block has exactly the
polynomial determined by any bijection inducing the same allocation. -/
theorem allocatedDenominator_of_equiv (b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (e : AllocationNodes m ≃ Fin n) (c : B) :
    allocatedDenominator b (allocationOfEquiv e) c =
      stieltjesDenominator (fun i : Fin (m c) => b (e ⟨c,i⟩)) := by
  let a := allocationOfEquiv e
  let f : Fin (m c) ≃ AllocationFiber a c :=
    Equiv.ofBijective (equivFiberMap e c) (equivFiberMap_bijective e c)
  have h1 := stieltjesDenominator_reindex (allocationEnumeration a c).toEquiv
    (fun z : AllocationFiber a c => b z.val)
  have h2 := stieltjesDenominator_reindex f (fun z : AllocationFiber a c => b z.val)
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/SpectralFactorMatching.lea:
import HydrologyTree.StieltjesReindex

/-! Exact matching of two full finite factorizations. Simple reference poles
force a genuine bijection; no numerical root matching or spectral oracle is used. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Equal full monic pole products with a simple reference determine a bijection
of every factor, even when simplicity was not assumed for the competing list. -/
theorem stieltjes_factor_matching {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (e0 : I ≃ J) (q : I → ℝ) (b : J → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hP : stieltjesDenominator q = stieltjesDenominator b) :
    ∃ e : I ≃ J, ∀ u, q u = b (e u) := by
  have hex (i : J) : ∃ u : I, q u = b i := by
    have h := stieltjesDenominator_eval_pole b i
    rw [← hP,eval_stieltjesDenominator,Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨u,_,hu⟩ := h
    exact ⟨u,by linarith⟩
  choose f hf using hex
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j hij
    apply hb
    rw [← hf i,← hf j,hij]
  have hsur : Function.Surjective f := by
    have hs := Finite.surjective_of_injective (e0.injective.comp hinj)
    intro u
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hs (e0 u)
    exact ⟨i,e0.injective hi⟩
  let E : J ≃ I := Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨hinj,hsur⟩
  refine ⟨E.symm,?_⟩
  intro u
  have h := hf (E.symm u)
  change q (E (E.symm u)) = b (E.symm u) at h
  simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

/-- Factor matching also proves simplicity of the competing enumeration. -/
theorem stieltjes_equal_product_injective {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (e0 : I ≃ J) (q : I → ℝ) (b : J → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hP : stieltjesDenominator q = stieltjesDenominator b) :
    Function.Injective q := by
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := stieltjes_factor_matching e0 q b hb hP
  intro i j hij
  apply e.injective
  apply hb
  rwa [← he i,← he j]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/StieltjesGrouping.lean:
import HydrologyTree.StieltjesReindex

/-! Exact regrouping of poles into arbitrary labelled child families. No
cross-cancellation or approximate partial fractions are used. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {B : Type*} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (m : B → ℕ)

lemma stieltjesDenominator_sigma (b : (Σ c, Fin (m c+1)) → ℝ) :
    stieltjesDenominator b = ∏ c, stieltjesDenominator (fun i => b ⟨c,i⟩) := by
  exact Fintype.prod_sigma _

lemma stieltjes_sigma_erased_product (b : (Σ c, Fin (m c+1)) → ℝ)
    (c : B) (i : Fin (m c+1)) :
    (∏ v ∈ Finset.univ.erase ⟨c,i⟩, (X+C (b v))) =
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (b ⟨c,j⟩))) *
        ∏ d ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, stieltjesDenominator (fun j => b ⟨d,j⟩) := by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (b ⟨c,i⟩)).ne_zero
  rw [Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun v : Σ c, Fin (m c+1) => (X+C (b v) : ℝ[X])) (Finset.mem_univ ⟨c,i⟩)]
  rw [← mul_assoc,Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun j : Fin (m c+1) => (X+C (b ⟨c,j⟩) : ℝ[X])) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  change stieltjesDenominator b = stieltjesDenominator (fun j => b ⟨c,j⟩) * _
  rw [stieltjesDenominator_sigma,Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun d => stieltjesDenominator (fun j : Fin (m d+1) => b ⟨d,j⟩)) (Finset.mem_univ c)]

/-- Numerator regrouping at polynomial level, including coincident poles. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_sigma (b g : (Σ c, Fin (m c+1)) → ℝ) :
    stieltjesNumerator b g =
      ∑ c, stieltjesNumerator (fun i => b ⟨c,i⟩) (fun i => g ⟨c,i⟩) *
        ∏ d ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, stieltjesDenominator (fun i => b ⟨d,i⟩) := by
  rw [stieltjesNumerator,Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  simp only [stieltjesNumerator,Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [stieltjes_sigma_erased_product]
  ring

lemma stieltjesNumerator_scale {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (b g : I → ℝ) (k : ℝ) :
    stieltjesNumerator b (fun i => k*g i) = C k * stieltjesNumerator b g := by
  simp only [stieltjesNumerator,map_mul,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

lemma stieltjesNumerator_normalization {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (b g : I → ℝ) (k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    C k * stieltjesNumerator b (fun i => g i/k) = stieltjesNumerator b g := by
  rw [← stieltjesNumerator_scale]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ (g i) hk

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/RootBranches.lean:
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalBridge

/-! Canonical root-branch partition of the original parent-encoded finite tree.
This is combinatorial data independent of every rate parameter. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The unique first vertex after root 0 on the parent path of v; root maps to 0. -/
def rootBranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : Fin (n+1) :=
  if hv : v = 0 then 0
  else if parentVertex t v = 0 then v
  else rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v)
termination_by v.val
decreasing_by exact parentVertex_lt t v hv

@[simp] lemma rootBranchVertex_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    rootBranchVertex t 0 = 0 := by rw [rootBranchVertex]; simp

lemma rootBranchVertex_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v = 0) : rootBranchVertex t v = v := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

lemma rootBranchVertex_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v = rootBranchVertex t (parentVertex t v) := by
  rw [rootBranchVertex]
  simp [hv,hp]

/-- A nonroot vertex belongs to a nonroot branch. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t v ≠ 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

/-- The branch representative is always a direct child of the root. -/
theorem rootBranchVertex_parent_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    parentVertex t (rootBranchVertex t v) = 0 := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
    · rwa [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
    · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]
      exact ih (parentVertex t v) (parentVertex_lt t v hv) hp

abbrev RootChild {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0 ∧ parentVertex t v = 0}

abbrev BranchVertex {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) :=
  {v : Fin (n+1) // rootBranchVertex t v = c.val}

lemma branchVertex_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    v.val ≠ 0 := by
  intro hv
  have hh := v.property
  rw [hv, rootBranchVertex_zero] at hh
  exact c.property.1 hh.symm

    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :

partition. No partition of the matrix is assumed as a proof input. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma rootBranch_edge_step {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (e : Fin n)
    (hp : t.parent e ≠ 0) :
    rootBranchVertex t e.succ = rootBranchVertex t (t.parent e) := by
  exact rootBranchVertex_step t e.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero e) hp

/-- Distinct nonroot branches have no direct physical transfer in either direction. -/
theorem compartment_cross_branch_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v w : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (hb : rootBranchVertex t v ≠ rootBranchVertex t w) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v w = 0 := by
  have hvw : v ≠ w := fun h => hb (congrArg (rootBranchVertex t) h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v w hvw]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = v ∧ e.succ = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h1]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh.symm
  have h2 : ¬(e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = w) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    have hp : t.parent e ≠ 0 := by rwa [h2]
    have hh := rootBranch_edge_step t e hp
    rw [h1,h2] at hh
    exact hb hh
  simp [h1,h2]

def physicalBranchMatrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) :
    Matrix (BranchVertex t c) (BranchVertex t c) ℝ :=
  (compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

theorem rootPartition_same_block {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v w : BranchVertex t c) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨c,w⟩) = physicalBranchMatrix t x c v w := rfl

theorem rootPartition_different_blocks {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c d : RootChild t) (hcd : c ≠ d) (v : BranchVertex t c) (w : BranchVertex t d) :
    ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix (rootPartitionEquiv t) (rootPartitionEquiv t))
      (.inr ⟨c,v⟩) (.inr ⟨d,w⟩) = 0 := by
  apply compartment_cross_branch_zero t x v.val w.val
    (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v) (branchVertex_ne_zero t d w)
  intro h
  apply hcd
  exact Subtype.ext (v.property.symm.trans (h.trans w.property))

    parentVertex t e.succ = t.parent e := rfl

/-- A nondirect descendant has no inward transfer to the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_column_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x 0 v = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x 0 v (Ne.symm hv)]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h1 : ¬(t.parent e = 0 ∧ e.succ = v) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    apply hp
    rw [← h2, parentVertex_succ, h1]
  simp [h1, Fin.succ_ne_zero]

/-- A nondirect descendant receives no outward transfer directly from the root. -/
theorem compartment_root_row_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hp : parentVertex t v ≠ 0) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v 0 = 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_formula t x v 0 hv]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  have h2 : ¬(e.succ = v ∧ t.parent e = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨h1,h2⟩
    apply hp
    rw [← h1, parentVertex_succ, h2]
  simp [h2, Fin.succ_ne_zero]

  intro hp

  by_cases h : v.val = c.val

    exact compartment_root_column_zero t x v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v)

theorem rootPartition_branch_to_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (c : RootChild t) (v : BranchVertex t c) :
    compartmentMatrix t x v.val 0 =
      if v.val = c.val then compartmentMatrix t x c.val 0 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : v.val = c.val
  · simp [h]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact compartment_root_row_zero t x v.val (branchVertex_ne_zero t c v)

    rootBranchVertex t v ≤ v := by

    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · subst v; simp
    · by_cases hp : parentVertex t v = 0
      · rw [rootBranchVertex_child t v hv hp]
      · rw [rootBranchVertex_step t v hv hp]

    branchRootVertex t c ≤ v := by

  exact v.property.symm.le.trans (rootBranchVertex_le t v.val)

    Fintype.card (BranchVertex t c) = childEdgeCount t c + 1 := by
  unfold childEdgeCount
  have := branch_card_pos t c
  omega

  Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq _ (child_card t c)

  · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := (childEnumeration t c).surjective (branchRootVertex t c)
    rw [← hj]
    exact (childEnumeration t c).monotone (Fin.zero_le j)
  · exact branchRoot_min t c _

  have he : childEnumeration t c i.succ = childEnumeration t c 0 := by
    rw [childEnumeration_zero]

    have hv := branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ)

    have h : (childEnumeration t c).symm (childParentVertex t c i) < i.succ := by
      apply (childEnumeration t c).lt_iff_lt.mp
      rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
      exact parentVertex_lt t _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c i.succ))

  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((childEnumeration t c).apply_symm_apply (childParentVertex t c i))

    childEdgeCount t c < n := by

      (⟨v.val, branchVertex_ne_zero t c v⟩ : {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0})) := by
    intro v w h
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0} => z.val) h)
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hi
  have hnon : Fintype.card {v : Fin (n+1) // v ≠ 0} = n := by
    simp
  rw [hnon, child_card] at hc
  omega

def vectorReindex {ι κ : Type*} (e : ι ≃ κ) : (κ → ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (ι → ℝ) where
  toFun f i := f (e i)
  invFun g j := g (e.symm j)

  right_inv g := by funext i; simp
  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

      ℝ × ((c : C) → VertexValues (m c)) where
  toFun f := (f (.inl ()), fun c i => f (.inr ⟨c,i⟩))
  invFun z v := match v with
    | .inl _ => z.1
    | .inr v => z.2 v.1 v.2
  left_inv f := by funext v; rcases v with u | ⟨c,i⟩; cases u <;> rfl; rfl

  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

  toFun f c i := f ⟨c,i⟩
  invFun g v := g v.1 v.2
  left_inv f := rfl
  right_inv g := rfl
  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

while the remaining outward coordinates are internal to the child. -/

    ((ℝ × ((c : C) → VertexValues (m c))) × ((c : C) → VertexValues (m c))) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
      ℝ × ((c : C) → ℝ × TreeRates (m c)) where
  toFun z := (z.1.1, fun c => (z.2 c 0, (z.1.2 c, fun i => z.2 c i.succ)))
  invFun z := ((z.1, fun c => (z.2 c).2.1), fun c => Fin.cons (z.2 c).1 (z.2 c).2.2)
  left_inv z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext c i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

  map_add' f g := rfl
  map_smul' c f := rfl

edge products. Its Jacobian is proved at zero rates, without dividing by leaks. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {C Y : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]

def sumCoordinates : (C → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ := ∑ c : C, ContinuousLinearMap.proj c

@[simp] lemma sumCoordinates_apply (f : C → ℝ) : sumCoordinates f = ∑ c, f c := by
  simp [sumCoordinates]

/-- With the child rates frozen, the root leak has coefficient one and each
connector has coefficient equal to its child leak. -/
def couplingFiber (a : C → ℝ) : (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)) +
    sumCoordinates.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c => a c •
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)))

@[simp] lemma couplingFiber_apply (a : C → ℝ) (z : ℝ × (C → ℝ)) :
    couplingFiber a z = (z.1 + ∑ c, z.2 c, fun c => a c * z.2 c) := by
  simp [couplingFiber]

lemma toMatrix_couplingFiber (a : C → ℝ) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C))
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)) (couplingFiber a).toLinearMap =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) (Matrix.of fun _ _ => 1) 0 (Matrix.diagonal a) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, couplingFiber, sumCoordinates,
      Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply,
      Pi.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C))
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ C)) (couplingFiber a).toLinearMap).det =
      ∏ c, a c := by
  rw [toMatrix_couplingFiber, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  simp

  (z.1, (z.2.1 + sumCoordinates z.2.2, fun c => a z.1 c * z.2.2 c))

def couplingCross (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (f : C → ℝ) : Y →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) :=
  (0 : Y →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c => f c • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp a)

def rootCouplingDerivative (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (z : Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :
    (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) →L[ℝ] (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ Y) (couplingCross a z.2.2) (couplingFiber (a z.1))

theorem hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (z : Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :
    HasFDerivAt (rootCoupling a) (rootCouplingDerivative a z) z := by
  let P : (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) →L[ℝ] Y := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ Y _
  let Q : (Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × (C → ℝ)) := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ Y _
  let L := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)).comp Q
  let F := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (C → ℝ)).comp Q
  have hd := L.hasFDerivAt.add (sumCoordinates.hasFDerivAt.comp z F.hasFDerivAt)
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun w => fun c => a (P w) c * F w c)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun c =>
        a (P z) c • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp F +
        F z c • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp (a.comp P)) z := by
    apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro c
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp (a.comp P)).hasFDerivAt.mul
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj c).comp F).hasFDerivAt

  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + sumCoordinates h.2.2 = 0 + (h.2.1 + sumCoordinates h.2.2)

theorem det_rootCouplingDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    (b : Basis ι ℝ Y) (a : Y →L[ℝ] (C → ℝ)) (z : Y × (ℝ × (C → ℝ))) :

  rw [(hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling a z).fderiv, det_rootCouplingDerivative]

  constructor
  · intro hp

    have he := (childEnumeration t c i).property.symm.trans h
    exact (childEnumeration_root_iff t c i).mp he.symm

    (fun e => if t.parent e = 0 then f e else 0), Fintype.sum_sigma]

  simp only [numberedEdge_parent, childEnumeration_parent_zero_iff]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · rw [ite_eq_left rfl, outward_at_numbered_child t f c 0, childEnumeration_zero]

  · intro i _ hi

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] {V : C → Type*}
  [∀ c, Fintype (V c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (V c)]

def arrowRow (r : ∀ c, V c) (a : C → ℝ) : Matrix Unit (Σ c, V c) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun _ z => if z.2 = r z.1 then a z.1 else 0

def arrowColumn (r : ∀ c, V c) (f : C → ℝ) : Matrix (Σ c, V c) Unit ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun z _ => if z.2 = r z.1 then f z.1 else 0

    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) : Matrix (Unit ⊕ (Σ c, V c)) (Unit ⊕ (Σ c, V c)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.of fun _ _ => d) (arrowRow r a) (arrowColumn r f)
    (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B)

  · intro d _ hdc
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne G j i hdc, mul_zero]

  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  simp only [arrowRow_mul_block]
  simp [arrowColumn, mul_ite]

    rw [det_dependent_blocks]

  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c _
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (B j).det) (Finset.mem_univ c),
      Matrix.inv_def]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]

    <;> ring

  · cases i; cases j; simp [arrowMatrix, Matrix.scalar_apply]
  · cases i; simp [arrowMatrix, arrowRow, Matrix.scalar_apply, neg_ite]
  · cases j; simp [arrowMatrix, arrowColumn, Matrix.scalar_apply, neg_ite]
  · have h := congrArg (fun M => M ⟨c,i⟩ ⟨e,j⟩) (scalar_sub_dependent_blocks B s)

      Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Sum.inr.injEq] using h

    Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun c _ => Matrix.charpoly_monic _)
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots _ hp.ne_zero).mono
  intro s hs
  have hB : ∀ c, (Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro c
    have hn : (∏ c, ((B c).charpoly).eval s) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_prod] using hs
    rw [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hn c (Finset.mem_univ c)

    Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_prod,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C,

  rw [diagonalCofactor, arrowMatrix, Matrix.charmatrix_fromBlocks, adjugate_root_block]

open Matrix Polynomial

namespace HydrologyTree

lemma root_outward_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x c.val 0 = outwardByVertex x.2 c.val := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula t x c.val 0 c.property.1]
  simp only [ite_eq_right c.property.1, c.property.2, ite_true, zero_add]

      (physicalBranchMatrix t x) (branchRootVertex t) (fun c => x.1 c.val)
      (fun c => outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) := by
  unfold physicalRootBlockMatrix arrowMatrix
  congr 1
  · ext u ⟨c,v⟩
    cases u
    simp [rootInwardRow, arrowRow, root_inward_child, branchRootVertex, Subtype.ext_iff]
  · ext ⟨c,v⟩ u

    simp [rootOutwardColumn, arrowColumn, root_outward_child, branchRootVertex, Subtype.ext_iff]

    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) (i : κ) :
    diagonalCofactor (A.submatrix e e) i = diagonalCofactor A (e i) := by
  change diagonalCofactor (A.reindex e.symm e.symm) i = _
  rw [diagonalCofactor, Matrix.charmatrix_reindex, Matrix.adjugate_reindex]
  rfl

    diagonalCofactor A 0 = (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly := by
  unfold diagonalCofactor
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, add_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]
  · simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne, h]

def childCharacteristic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ[X] :=
  physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

def childCofactor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ[X] :=
  physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

/-- Root cofactor of the original matrix equals the product of all actual child denominators. -/
theorem physicalRootCofactor_child_product {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRootCofactor t x = ∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c := by
  have h := congrArg (fun M => diagonalCofactor M (.inl ())) (physical_root_block_decomposition t x)
  rw [diagonalCofactor_reindex, rootPartitionEquiv_root, diagonalCofactor_zero,
    physicalRootBlock_eq_arrow] at h

  apply (cofactor_arrowMatrix (-(rateChart t x).1 0) (physicalBranchMatrix t x)
    (branchRootVertex t) (fun c => x.1 c.val) (fun c => outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)).trans
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  exact physicalBranch_charpoly_eq t c x

  simp only [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, physicalBranch_charpoly_eq,
    physicalBranch_cofactor_eq, childCharacteristic, childCofactor, physicalCharacteristic] at hh ⊢
  convert hh using 1
  congr 3

namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Strict positivity of all physical rates, including the root leak. -/

  (∀ v, 0 < x.1 v) ∧ ∀ e, 0 < x.2 e

def assemblePositiveRates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (l : ℝ)
    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) : TreeRates n :=
  (ratePartitionEquiv t).symm (l,fun c => (f c,y c))

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) :
    (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 0 = l := by
  have h := congrArg Prod.fst ((ratePartitionEquiv t).apply_symm_apply (l,fun c => (f c,y c)))
  exact h

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    outwardByVertex (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).2 c.val = f c ∧
      childRates t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y) = y c := by
  have h := congrArg (fun z : PartitionedRates t => z.2 c)
    ((ratePartitionEquiv t).apply_symm_apply (l,fun c => (f c,y c)))
  change (ratePartitionEquiv t (assemblePositiveRates t l f y)).2 c = (f c,y c) at h
  rw [ratePartition_child] at h
  exact Prod.mk.inj h

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    childRates t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y) = y c := (assembledRates_extract t l f y c).2

lemma assembledRates_connector {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (l : ℝ)
    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    outwardByVertex (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).2 c.val = f c :=
  (assembledRates_extract t l f y c).1

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 c.val = (y c).1 0 := by
  rw [← childRates_leak t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y),assembledRates_child]

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) :
    (rateChart t (assemblePositiveRates t l f y)).1 0 = l+∑ c, f c := by
  change (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 0 + parentCLM t (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).2 0 = _

  simp only [assembledRates_connector]

    (hf : ∀ c, 0 < f c) (hy : ∀ c, PositiveRateVector (y c)) :
    PositiveRateVector (assemblePositiveRates t l f y) := by
  constructor
  · intro v
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun e => ?_) v
    · rwa [assembledRates_root]
    · obtain ⟨⟨c,i⟩,he⟩ := (numberedEdgeEquiv t).surjective e
      rw [← he]
      change 0 < (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 (numberedEdgeIndex t ⟨c,i⟩).succ

    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i

      exact (assembledRates_connector t l f y c).symm ▸ hf c
    · change 0 < (childRates t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y)).2 j
      rw [assembledRates_child]
      exact (hy c).2 j

      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (childCharacteristic t x j).eval 0)

      ∏ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ := by
  change (∏ c : RootChild t, ∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
    x.1 (childEnumeration t c i).val) = _

    x.1 (childEnumeration t z.1 z.2).val)]

theorem physical_root_leak_eq_ratio {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) :
    x.1 0 = (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval 0 / (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval 0 := by
  rw [physicalCharacteristic_eval_zero_leak]
  exact (mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero_ne_zero t x ha)).symm

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.StieltjesGrouping
import HydrologyTree.PositiveRateAssembly
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalConstants

/-! Conservative positive reconstruction for any prescribed grouping of the
reciprocal poles. The assembled object is the original rate-indexed tree,
not a substitute matrix or an assumed realization. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma realized_child_connector {k : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree k) (x : TreeRates k)
    (b g : Fin (k+1) → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hx : PositiveRateVector x) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (hP : physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator b)
    (hF : physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator b (fun i => g i/c)) :
    c/x.1 0 = ∑ i, g i/b i := by
  have hF0 := physicalRootCofactor_eval_zero_pos t x (fun i => hx.1 i.succ)
  have hconst := physicalCharacteristic_eval_zero_leak t x
  have hscale := congrArg (fun Q : ℝ[X] => Q.eval 0)
    (stieltjesNumerator_normalization b g c hc)
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_C] at hscale
  have hsum := stieltjes_sum_mul_denominator b g 0 (fun i => by simpa using ne_of_gt (hb i))
  simp only [zero_add] at hsum
  rw [← hF] at hscale
  rw [← hP] at hsum
  apply (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt (hx.1 0))).mpr
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hF0)
  calc
    c*(physicalRootCofactor t x).eval 0 = (stieltjesNumerator b g).eval 0 := hscale
    _ = (∑ i, g i/b i)*(physicalCharacteristic t x).eval 0 := hsum.symm
    _ = ((∑ i, g i/b i)*x.1 0)*(physicalRootCofactor t x).eval 0 := by rw [hconst]; ring

/-- One complete positive root reconstruction from actual positive child
realizations and any bijective pole allocation. This is the induction step;
existence of all child realizations is discharged in the all-tree theorem. -/
theorem assemble_positive_stieltjes_children {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (e : NumberedChildNodes t ≃ Fin n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i)
    (y : ChildStates t) (hy : ∀ c, PositiveRateVector (y c))
    (hP : ∀ c, physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (y c) =
      stieltjesDenominator (fun i => b (e ⟨c,i⟩)))
    (hF : ∀ c, physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (y c) =
      stieltjesNumerator (fun i => b (e ⟨c,i⟩))
        (fun i => g (e ⟨c,i⟩)/(∑ j : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1), g (e ⟨c,j⟩)))) :
    ∃ x : TreeRates n, PositiveRateVector x ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesDenominator b ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = (X+C d)*stieltjesDenominator b-stieltjesNumerator b g ∧
      (∀ c, childRates t c x = y c) := by
  let mass : RootChild t → ℝ := fun c => ∑ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1), g (e ⟨c,i⟩)
  have hm (c : RootChild t) : 0 < mass c :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hg _) Finset.univ_nonempty
  let f : RootChild t → ℝ := fun c => mass c/(y c).1 0
  have hf (c : RootChild t) : 0 < f c := div_pos (hm c) ((hy c).1 0)
  have hfval (c : RootChild t) : f c=∑ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),g (e ⟨c,i⟩)/b (e ⟨c,i⟩) :=
    realized_child_connector (childTree t c) (y c) _ _ (mass c) (ne_of_gt (hm c))
      (hy c) (fun i => hb _) (hP c) (hF c)
  have hfsum : (∑ c, f c) = ∑ i : Fin n, g i/b i := by
    simp only [hfval]
    exact (Fintype.sum_sigma (fun v : NumberedChildNodes t => g (e v)/b (e v))).symm.trans
      (e.sum_comp (fun i => g i/b i))
  let l := d-∑ i, g i/b i
  let x := assemblePositiveRates t l f y
  have hx := assemblePositiveRates_positive t l f y hl hf hy
  have hchildren (c : RootChild t) : childRates t c x=y c := assembledRates_child t l f y c
  have hPchild (c : RootChild t) : childCharacteristic t x c =
      stieltjesDenominator (fun i => b (e ⟨c,i⟩)) := by
    change physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) = _
    rw [hchildren,hP]
  have hFchild (c : RootChild t) : childCofactor t x c =
      stieltjesNumerator (fun i => b (e ⟨c,i⟩)) (fun i => g (e ⟨c,i⟩)/mass c) := by
    change physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) = _
    rw [hchildren,hF]
  have hwhole : (∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c) = stieltjesDenominator b := by
    simp only [hPchild]
    exact (stieltjesDenominator_sigma (childEdgeCount t) (fun v => b (e v))).symm.trans
      (stieltjesDenominator_reindex e b)
  have hden : physicalRootCofactor t x=stieltjesDenominator b := by
    rw [physicalRootCofactor_child_product,hwhole]
  have hdiag : (rateChart t x).1 0=d := by
    rw [assembledRates_diagonal,hfsum]
    exact sub_add_cancel _ _
  have hedge (c : RootChild t) : x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val=mass c := by
    rw [assembledRates_child_leak,assembledRates_connector]
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt ((hy c).1 0))
  have hnum : (∑ c : RootChild t, C (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)*childCofactor t x c *
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, childCharacteristic t x j) = stieltjesNumerator b g := by
    simp only [hedge,hFchild,hPchild,stieltjesNumerator_normalization _ _ _ (ne_of_gt (hm _))]
    exact (stieltjesNumerator_sigma (childEdgeCount t) (fun v => b (e v))
      (fun v => g (e v))).symm.trans (stieltjesNumerator_reindex e b g)
  refine ⟨x,hx,hden,?_,hchildren⟩
  rw [physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion,hdiag,hwhole,hnum]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Coprime.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination

/-! Global, not merely local, uniqueness of the branch numerator decomposition
for prescribed pairwise coprime child denominators. This proves the algebraic
recovery step used by constructive tree realizations. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

/-- The actual polynomial sum of each numerator times all other denominators. -/
def branchNumeratorSum (P R : I → ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X] :=
  ∑ i : I, R i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j

/-- Unique exact numerator decomposition, valid over every finite branch family.
The degree conditions are actual polynomial degree bounds, not sample tests. -/
theorem coprime_branch_numerators_unique (P R S : I → ℝ[X])
    (hP : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (P i) (P j))
    (hR : ∀ i, (R i).degree < (P i).degree)
    (hS : ∀ i, (S i).degree < (P i).degree)
    (h : branchNumeratorSum P R = branchNumeratorSum P S) : R = S := by
  have hz : (∑ i : I, (R i-S i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) = 0 := by
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h
  funext i
  have hd : P i ∣ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      (R j-S j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, P k := by
    apply Finset.dvd_sum
    intro j hj
    apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_right
    exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem P (by simp [Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1])
  have he := Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
    (fun j : I => (R j-S j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, P k) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [hz] at he
  have hterm : (R i-S i) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) =
      -(∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (R j-S j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, P k) := by
    linear_combination he
  have hdiv : P i ∣ (R i-S i) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) := by
    rw [hterm]
    exact dvd_neg.mpr hd
  have hc : IsCoprime (P i) (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) := by
    apply IsCoprime.prod_right
    intro j hj
    exact hP i j (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)
  have hdiff : (R i-S i).degree < (P i).degree :=
    (Polynomial.degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (max_lt (hR i) (hS i))
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Polynomial.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt
    (hc.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdiv) hdiff)

/-- Uniqueness also holds modulo the full denominator product. This is the
form needed when the unknown root diagonal contributes a multiple of that product. -/
theorem coprime_branch_numerators_unique_mod_product (P R S : I → ℝ[X])
    (hP : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (P i) (P j))
    (hR : ∀ i, (R i).degree < (P i).degree)
    (hS : ∀ i, (S i).degree < (P i).degree)
    (h : (∏ i : I, P i) ∣ branchNumeratorSum P R - branchNumeratorSum P S) : R = S := by
  have hsum : (∑ i : I, (R i-S i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) =
      branchNumeratorSum P R - branchNumeratorSum P S := by
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, branchNumeratorSum]
  funext i
  have hall : P i ∣ ∑ j : I, (R j-S j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, P k := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem P (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans h
  have hd : P i ∣ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      (R j-S j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, P k := by
    apply Finset.dvd_sum
    intro j hj
    apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_right
    exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem P (by simp [Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1])
  have he := Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ
    (fun j : I => (R j-S j) * ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, P k) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [← he] at hall
  have hdiv : P i ∣ (R i-S i) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using dvd_sub hall hd
  have hc : IsCoprime (P i) (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, P j) := by
    apply IsCoprime.prod_right
    intro j hj
    exact hP i j (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1)
  have hdiff : (R i-S i).degree < (P i).degree :=
    (Polynomial.degree_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (max_lt (hR i) (hS i))
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Polynomial.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_degree_lt
    (hc.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdiv) hdiff)

/-- A monic polynomial times a nonzero scalar is recovered completely, including
its scale, from its actual coefficients. -/
theorem scalar_monic_polynomial_unique (P Q : ℝ[X]) (hP : P.Monic) (hQ : Q.Monic)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : C a * P = C b * Q) : a = b ∧ P = Q := by
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb
    rw [hb, map_zero, zero_mul] at h
    exact (mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr ha) hP.ne_zero) h
  have hc := congrArg Polynomial.leadingCoeff h
  simp only [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C, hP.leadingCoeff,
    hQ.leadingCoeff, mul_one] at hc
  refine ⟨hc,?_⟩
  rw [← hc] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr ha) h

end HydrologyTree

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Determinant

/-! Basis-independent determinant calculus for the actual finite-dimensional
Fréchet derivative. Used after explicit coefficient permutation equivalences. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- Determinant of the actual derivative of an endomorphism. -/
def endJacobian (f : E → E) (x : E) : ℝ := LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap

lemma endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt {f : E → E} {L : E →L[ℝ] E} {x : E}
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f L x) : endJacobian f x = LinearMap.det L.toLinearMap := by
  rw [endJacobian, hf.fderiv]

theorem endJacobian_comp {f g : E → E} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g x)) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    endJacobian (f ∘ g) x = endJacobian f (g x) * endJacobian g x := by
  rw [endJacobian, (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x hg.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
  exact LinearMap.det_comp _ _

/-- Conjugation transports coordinates without changing the derivative determinant. -/
theorem endJacobian_conjugate (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (f : E → E) (x : F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (e.symm x)) :
    endJacobian (fun z => e (f (e.symm z))) x = endJacobian f (e.symm x) := by
  have h := e.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt)
  have he : fderiv ℝ (fun z => e (f (e.symm z))) x =
      e.toContinuousLinearMap.comp ((fderiv ℝ f (e.symm x)).comp e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, he]
  change LinearMap.det (e.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.comp
    ((fderiv ℝ f (e.symm x)).toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap)) = _
  exact LinearMap.det_conj _ e.toLinearEquiv

/-- Triangular block determinant, independent of the choice of bases. -/
lemma endDet_lowerBlock [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.det (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.det L.toLinearMap * LinearMap.det M.toLinearMap := by
  simpa only [LinearMap.det_toMatrix] using
    det_lowerBlock (Module.finBasis ℝ E) (Module.finBasis ℝ F) L C M

/-- A map on the first factor and identity on the second factor. -/
def keepFunction (f : E → E) (z : E × F) : E × F := (f z.1,z.2)

lemma hasFDerivAt_keepFunction {f : E → E} (x : E × F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.1) :
    HasFDerivAt (keepFunction (F := F) f)
      ((fderiv ℝ f x.1).prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)) x := by
  exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt).prodMk
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt

lemma endJacobian_keepFunction [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (f : E → E) (x : E × F) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.1) :
    endJacobian (keepFunction (F := F) f) x = endJacobian f x.1 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction x hf)]
  change LinearMap.det (LinearMap.prodMap (fderiv ℝ f x.1).toLinearMap (LinearMap.id : F →ₗ[ℝ] F)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.det_prodMap, LinearMap.det_id, mul_one]
  rfl

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! The monic-numerator scaling factor, including zero scale and degree zero. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Generic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) : ℝ × E := (x.1, x.1 • x.2)

def scaleChartDerivative (x : ℝ × E) : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).prod
    (x.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight x.2)

/-- The actual derivative of multiplication of the lower coefficients by the scale. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) :
    HasFDerivAt scaleChart (scaleChartDerivative x) x := by
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.prodMk
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.smul
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt)

lemma toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 0
      (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Unit) => b.repr x.2 i) (x.1 • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

/-- An all-dimensional, all-scale determinant identity, not a generic-rank statement. -/
theorem det_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap).det =
      x.1 ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp [Matrix.det_smul]

end Generic

/-- Multiplication of an actual monic polynomial by its unrestricted scalar. -/
def scaleMonic {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) := x.1 • monicPoly x.2

lemma scaleMonic_eq_comp {n : ℕ} :
    scaleMonic (n := n) = (leadingEquiv n) ∘ scaleChart := by
  funext x
  rw [scaleMonic, monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv]
  symm
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, scaleChart, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
    (leadingEquiv n).map_smul x.1 (1,x.2)

def scaleMonicDerivative {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (ℝ × Coeff n) →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (scaleChartDerivative x)

theorem hasFDerivAt_scaleMonic {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt scaleMonic (scaleMonicDerivative x) x := by
  rw [scaleMonic_eq_comp]
  exact (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp
    x (hasFDerivAt_scaleChart x)

lemma toMatrix_comp_equiv {E F G : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module ℝ G]
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (e : F ≃ₗ[ℝ] G) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix bE (bF.map e) (e.toLinearMap.comp L) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Basis.map_repr]

/-- The Jacobian in the manuscript's leading-first numerator coefficient order. -/
def monicScalingJacobian {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n))
    (leadingBasis n) (fderiv ℝ scaleMonic x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The exact factor c^n for a monic polynomial of degree n. -/
theorem monicScalingJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    monicScalingJacobian x = x.1 ^ n := by
  rw [monicScalingJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_scaleMonic x).fderiv, leadingBasis]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _
    ((leadingEquiv n).toLinearMap.comp (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap)).det = _
  rw [toMatrix_comp_equiv, det_scaleChartDerivative]
  simp

end HydrologyTree
